title: Fix first admin authentication and build complete admin dashboard with server and plan management

requirements.summary: Create an admin dashboard page that displays comprehensive lists of all dedicated servers with their current status, specifications, and assignment information
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows all servers in a table or card layout
Each server displays status (active, inactive, pending)
Server specs are visible (CPU, RAM, storage)
Assignment information shows which user or plan owns each server
Dashboard is only accessible to admin users

file_operations.description: Add a new 'Servers' tab to the admin page that displays all dedicated servers with status, specs, and assignment info. Use the authorization component to protect this view with admin-only access. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Use getAllDedicatedServers() to fetch server data and display in a table or card layout showing id, name, cpuCores, ramGb, storageGb, status, assignedTo, createdAt, and updatedAt.

requirements.summary: Implement server creation functionality allowing admins to specify name, specifications (CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB), and initial status
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access a 'Create Server' form or dialog
Form includes fields for server name, CPU cores, RAM amount, storage capacity
Server is created with 'available' status by default
New server appears in the dashboard list immediately after creation
Backend persists the new server data

file_operations.description: Add a useCreateDedicatedServer mutation hook that calls actor.createDedicatedServer(id, name, cpuCores, ramGb, storageGb) and invalidates the 'dedicatedServers' query key on success to refresh the server list.

Create a dialog component with a form containing inputs for server ID, name, CPU cores (number), RAM GB (number), and storage GB (number). Use the useCreateDedicatedServer hook from useQueries.ts. Show validation errors and success toast. Use shadcn/ui Dialog and Form components. The dialog should be triggered from the admin page Servers tab.
Add a 'Create Server' button to the Servers tab that opens the CreateServerDialog. Position it above the servers table/list.

requirements.summary: Implement server assignment functionality allowing admins to assign servers to specific user accounts or to subscription plans
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a server and choose to assign it to a user or a plan
Dropdown or search interface to select target user by name/email
Dropdown or search interface to select target plan
Assigned servers show their assignment in the dashboard
Backend tracks assignment type (user or plan) and target ID
Servers can be reassigned or unassigned

file_operations.description: Add useAssignServerToUser and useAssignServerToPlan mutation hooks that call actor.assignServerToUser(serverId, user) and actor.assignServerToPlan(serverId, planId) respectively, invalidating 'dedicatedServers' on success. Add useGetAllUsers query hook that calls actor.getAllUsers() to fetch users for selection.

Create a dialog component with radio buttons to choose assignment type (user or plan), a dropdown/combobox to select user (using useGetAllUsers) or plan (using existing useGetServerPlans), and assign/unassign buttons. Use the useAssignServerToUser and useAssignServerToPlan hooks. Accept serverId as prop. Use shadcn/ui Dialog, RadioGroup, and Select components.

Add an 'Assign' action button for each server in the Servers tab that opens the AssignServerDialog with the selected serverId. Display assignment info in the server list (assignedTo field showing user principal or plan ID).

requirements.summary: Implement server deletion functionality allowing admins to permanently remove servers from the system with confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button or action available for each server in the dashboard
Confirmation dialog appears before deletion
Deletion removes server from backend storage
Deleted server disappears from dashboard immediately
Cannot delete servers that are currently assigned (or requires force delete confirmation)

file_operations.description: Add useDeleteDedicatedServer mutation hook that calls actor.deleteDedicatedServer(serverId) and invalidates 'dedicatedServers' query key on success.

Create a confirmation dialog component that accepts serverId and server name as props. Show warning message that deletion is permanent. If server.assignedTo is present, show additional warning about assigned server. Use useDeleteDedicatedServer hook. Use shadcn/ui AlertDialog component.
Add a 'Delete' action button for each server in the Servers tab that opens the DeleteServerDialog with the selected serverId and name.

requirements.summary: Create a subscription plans management interface displaying all plans with their pricing, specifications, and billing periods
acceptanceCriteria: Plans are displayed in a table or card layout in the admin dashboard
Each plan shows name, price, CPU/RAM/storage specs, and billing period
Plans section is organized separately from servers section
Admin can view all active and inactive plans

file_operations.description: Enhance the existing 'Plans' tab to display all plan details including pricePerMonth, cpu, ram, storage, bandwidth, location, available status, and billing period (currently plans are monthly, note this in the UI). Ensure the layout clearly shows all plan specifications in a structured table or card grid.

requirements.summary: Implement plan creation and editing functionality allowing admins to define subscription plans with name, price, server specifications, and billing period
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create new plans via a form or dialog
Form includes fields for plan name, price amount, CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB
Billing period selector with options: Monthly, Quarterly, Annually
Admin can edit existing plans
Changes to plans are reflected in the frontend Plans page for customers
Backend persists plan data

file_operations.description: Add a billing period dropdown to the existing plan creation/edit form in the Plans tab with options: Monthly, Quarterly, Annually. Store billing period in the plan's metadata or description field since the backend currently supports monthly pricing. Update the form labels to clarify pricing is per billing period. Ensure the edit plan functionality uses updateServerPlan with all fields including the new billing period.
Update the customer-facing Plans page to display the billing period for each plan if available. Show pricing as 'X per month/quarter/year' based on the plan's billing period metadata.

requirements.summary: Integrate Stripe API for payment processing, allowing admins to configure Stripe secret key and for users to purchase subscription plans through Stripe checkout
acceptanceCriteria: Stripe secret key configuration interface accessible to admins (already exists in StripeSetupModal)
Users can select a plan and initiate checkout
Checkout redirects to Stripe for payment processing
Successful payments create orders/subscriptions in the backend
Payment success and failure pages handle redirect flows
Backend validates Stripe webhook signatures for security

file_operations.description: Ensure the checkout flow uses the existing checkout mutation which calls actor.checkout(successUrl, cancelUrl). The checkout function already integrates with Stripe via the stripe component. Verify that the success and failure URLs point to '/payment-success' and '/payment-failure' respectively. Use the stripe component's checkout session creation which includes proper JSON parsing and URL validation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the payment success page handles the Stripe redirect properly and displays order confirmation. The page should use URL parameters to extract sessionId if needed and call actor.getPaymentStatus(sessionId) to verify payment completion. Clear the shopping cart as already implemented.
Ensure the payment failure page handles the Stripe redirect properly and provides clear error messaging. Extract error details from URL parameters if available using the urlParams utility.
